answer.book: Geiger's 1654 Zürich disputation 'Quaestiones miscellae physico-metaphysicae', respondent Casparus Wyssius: a title page, two dedications, then a Physica part and a Metaphysica part, each with three numbered quaestiones, followed by annexed theses and a run of commendatory poems numbered I–VII.
